basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Project Scientist, Project Assistant Posts
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) Industrial Research & Development Unit has announced 2 vacancies for Project Scientist and Project Assistant (Tech.) posts on a contract basis. Qualifications vary by post, requiring a PhD or graduate degree with relevant experience as specified in the official notification. The notified pay ranges from Rs. 47,790 - Rs. 62,350 per month. plus HRA @30% for the Project Scientist post and Rs. 39,420 - Rs. 51,420 per month. plus HRA @30% for the Project Assistant (Tech.) post, with appointments renewable yearly or up to the project duration. Candida

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD website (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill out the form completely with required educational qualifications indicating percentage of marks/division, details of work experience, etc.
Email the completed form along with detailed CV to Prof. Neetu Singh at email id: [email protected].
Mention the advertisement number of the project on the subject line of the email.
Ensure the application is submitted by 30/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Project Scientist at a Glance

rows.details: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi)
Development of a Multi-Well Electrochemical Device (SEPSOR) for Sepsis Biomarker Detection in Clinical Settings (Sub-project under main WIN CoE project # RP04898)
Wadhwani Innovation Network, Wadhwani Foundation, New Delhi
Upto 15/01/2028 (Renewable yearly or upto the duration of the project)
Rs. 47,790 - Rs. 62,350/- p.m. plus HRA @30% (Project Scientist); Rs. 39,420 - Rs. 51,420/- p.m. plus HRA @30% (Project Assistant)

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable Qualification for Project Scientist: Work experience in clinical settings handling clinical samples, electrode designing, system miniaturization, sensor biofabrication & electrode designing is preferred.

rows.essential_qualification: PhD in Biomedical Engineering / Biotechnology / Life Sciences or other related field having 1st class or equivalent.

Graduate degree in Biotechnology / Life Sciences / Biomedical or other related fields with 2 years of work experience in Biosensor fabrication, designing, hands on experience with qPCR, ELISA & microbiological studies is required.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The appointment shall be on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The pay scales include House Rent Allowance (HRA) @30% as specified for each post.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Project Scientist Job Description
content_sections.text: The project is focused on the "Development of a Multi-Well Electrochemical Device (SEPSOR) for Sepsis Biomarker Detection in Clinical Settings" under the main WIN CoE project (# RP04898). Selected candidates will work on biosensor development, clinical sample handling, and related technical tasks as outlined by the Principal Investigator, Prof. Neetu Singh.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project. Only short-listed candidates will be informed for online interview. Details regarding interview dates and online interview links will be communicated by email to shortlisted candidates by Prof. Neetu Singh at email id: [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Delhi Project Scientist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the completed application by email is 30/10/2026 by 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies: 1 for Project Scientist and 1 for Project Assistant (Tech.).

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply by email using Form No. IRD/REC-4 sent to [email protected].

faq.question: Q4. Is this appointment permanent or on contract?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay, renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q5. What are the salary ranges for the posts?
faq.answer: The pay ranges from Rs. 47,790 - Rs. 62,350/- p.m. plus HRA @30% for Project Scientist and Rs. 39,420 - Rs. 51,420/- p.m. plus HRA @30% for Project Assistant (Tech.).

faq.question: Q6. What is the essential qualification for Project Scientist?
faq.answer: Candidates require a PhD in Biomedical Engineering / Biotechnology / Life Sciences or other related field having 1st class or equivalent.

faq.question: Q7. Who gets relaxation in marks during selection?
faq.answer: A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for the interview?
faq.answer: IIT Delhi will shortlist eligible candidates based on qualifications, and short-listed candidates will be informed for an online interview.
